### Workflow and problem

What are you trying to draw or deliver? Identify the current limitation and its practical effect.

### Proposed behavior

Describe command names/options, point or selection behavior, model/paper context, units and expected output. A small synthetic example is useful.

### Alternatives and compatibility

Describe existing workarounds and any native-file, scripting, Undo/Redo or viewport-scale expectations. Link published reference behavior when relevant; do not attach extracted proprietary code/assets or client drawings.

### Scope

Separate the smallest useful change from future extensions. A request does not commit the project to an implementation or date. Report a reproducible crash/data loss/incorrect implemented behavior through the bug template.
